title: WatchdogPolicy
description: P-005 §7.2 versioned watchdog policy. Different tasks may tighten or disable steer, but cannot disable redaction, lease, or evidence truthfulness. Default behavior is notify (not auto-abort).

policyId.description: Versioned policy identifier. Bumping this signals a schema change.

maxReadOnlyActionsWithoutEvidence.description: Number of consecutive read-only actions without productive evidence before no_progress_detected fires.

maxNoProductiveMs.description: Time in ms with no productive evidence before no_progress_detected fires. Default 600000 (10 min).

maxNoHeartbeatMs.description: Time in ms without heartbeat before heartbeat_lost fires. Default 90000 (90 s).

maxSteerAttempts.description: Maximum steer attempts per attempt. Per P-005 §7.2: bounded to 1. Setting 0 disables steer entirely.

steerGraceMs.description: After a steer attempt, the grace period during which productive evidence cancels the exhausted path. Default 120000 (120 s).

onExhausted.description: Behavior after grace expires without recovery. notify (default) emits diagnostic and notifies Coordinator. abort requires explicit policy + 4-gate verification.

notifyChannel.description: Optional override for notification routing. coordination routes through Application Service projection; silent emits diagnostic only.
